summary: Observation: D5 original FS-GG/FS.GG.Templates 40121103111/a1 (main 026d2399, Root-delegated single dispatch, T0 2026-10-24T18:31:35Z) with the hosted AppArmor sysctl step passed the literal user-namespace prerequisite, SDK/Go/public packages, receiver creation and receiver checks for raw-omitted, provider-omitted and wizard-omitted, and on provider-omitted the actual default quint-specification-v1 typed-sdd provision/author/inspect plus the wrong-profile refusal (blocked, QUINT-PROFILE-IDENTITY, no changed paths, identical owner snapshots). It then failed at ProviderTool current-d5-backend-check because validateCurrentD5Backend required a work/d5-default/ entry that exists only in its synthetic fixture; SDD 2.4.0 Quint-v2 author writes readiness/<work>/ and the model path only. The checker was corrected in Templates#778 and verified by replay against the real 271-entry snapshot; wizard-omitted backend was never reached. Lesson: model synthetic receiver fixtures on real public-tool output before spending an original. Limits: n=1; the run qualified 0 of 43 receivers, the corrected checker has not run in an original, and a second original needs a new Root selection.
title: First genuine D5 original 40121103111 passed the hosted namespace gate and failed on a qualifier layout assumption
